name: Ton-Up Terry

intro.text: A 'ton' is a hundred miles an hour. We used to do it on the bypass, from the café to the roundabout and back before the record finished on the jukebox.
Scooters? Hairdryers on wheels. Come on, then.

win: Alright, alright. You've got a bit of oil in you after all.
after: Leather, grease and a Triumph. That's the uniform. The mods can keep their parkas.
